description.narrative: The most significant expected project-level outcomes are increased access to finance for MSMEs, in a market heavily impacted by the current volatile environment. Beyond the project outcomes, IFC anticipates that this Project will contribute to the resilience of the enterprise finance market in Ukraine through the demonstration and replication channel as part of a systematic intervention involving several RSFs with private sector lenders in the market.

The proposed investment consists of an unfunded risk sharing facility (RSF) with JSC CB PrivatBank (PrivatBank or the Bank) for a portfolio of loans, guarantees, leases and other eligible facilities to micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), including those in agribusiness and women-owned MSMEs in the amount of up to US$100 million in Ukraine (the Project). IFC's risk participation in the RSF will be up to US$50 million, or 50% of the aforementioned portfolio. The Project is expected to be supported by Blended Finance contributors under the Economic Resilience Action Program (ERA) for Ukraine, as described in the Blended Finance section.
